I'm a PhD candidate in Regional Development at the University of Pécs, Hungary, working on regional innovation, technological diversification and efficiency analysis. Before and alongside the PhD, I've worked as a data analyst and consultant for humanitarian, research and private organisations.


[Download the PDF](/files/academic-cv.pdf){.cv-download}


## How I work

I build pipelines so the analysis runs itself, and my time goes into the reporting.

```{r}
#| label: how-i-work
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)

ink   <- "#4e1d4c"
paper <- "#ebd3a2"
gdtools::register_gfont("Literata")

workflow <- here::here("cv", "workflow.yml") |>
  yaml::read_yaml() |>
  map(as_tibble) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(
    x   = row_number(),
    tip = glue::glue(
      "<strong>{stage}</strong><br><em>{tools}</em><br><br>{how}<br><br>{example}"
    )
  )

p <- workflow |>
  ggplot(aes(x, 0)) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 4, y = 0, yend = 0,
           colour = ink, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("path",
         x = c(4, 4, 1, 1),
         y = c(-0.45, -0.8, -0.8, -0.45),
         colour = ink, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed",
         linejoin = "mitre",
         arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = -1.2,
           label = "change anything, and only what depends on it reruns",
           family = "Literata", fontface = "italic", colour = ink, size = 4) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = stage),
                         size = 9, shape = 21, fill = paper,
                         colour = ink, stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_text_interactive(aes(y = 0.45, label = stage, tooltip = tip, data_id = stage),
                        family = "Literata", fontface = "bold",
                        colour = ink, size = 5.5) +
  geom_text_interactive(aes(y = -0.3, label = short, tooltip = tip, data_id = stage),
                        family = "Literata", colour = ink, size = 3.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 4.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.4, 0.8)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = paper, colour = NA))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false


girafe(
  ggobj = p, width_svg = 8, height_svg = 3, bg = paper,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(css = "fill:#4e1d4c;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.3;"),
    opts_tooltip(css = paste(
      "background:#4e1d4c; color:#ebd3a2; padding:10px 14px;",
      "font-family:Literata,serif; border-radius:2px; max-width:320px;"
    )),
    opts_toolbar(saveaspng = FALSE),
    opts_sizing(rescale = F)
  )
)
```

::: {#timeline}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const tabs = document.querySelector(".cv-tabs");
  const entries = document.querySelectorAll(".cv-entry");
  if (!tabs || !entries.length) return;

  tabs.hidden = false;   // tabs appear only when the script runs

  tabs.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const tab = event.target.closest("button[data-filter]");
    if (!tab) return;
    const filter = tab.dataset.filter;

    tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b) =>
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b === tab ? "true" : "false"));

    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      entry.hidden = filter !== "all" && entry.dataset.group !== filter;
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
